BrochureContent.Content:
Delightfully set in the heart of Miltown Malbay town on the doorstep of the Wild Atlantic Way, Pat considine Auctioneers are delighted to offer this newly renovated property onto the open market. Fresh from a complete overhaul the property is in excellent condition and is ideal as an investment property.

Miltown Malbay is a delightful costal town in west Clare, located along the Wild Atlantic Way and is nestled in between Spanish Point and Lahinch. The town itself offers a wide range of including amenities such as supermarkets, schools, cafés, restaurants, hotels, playground, as well as a great selection of sandy beaches and golf courses.

The residence has been renovated to an extremely high standard and comprises of an entrance hall, two bedrooms, utility and shower room on the ground floor. The first floor contains an open plan kitchen/living room, shower room and bedroom. The house has 104 sq. metres over the two floors with light filled accommodation throughout.
